roles.title: Full-Stack Software Engineer
roles.summary: Circular-economy logistics for stadiums, venues, and restaurants.
highlights: Sole engineer of the production operations platform — Go and Echo over PostgreSQL and GraphQL, with a Next.js and TypeScript frontend — now the company's system of record in place of a no-code stack.
Modeled the reuse-logistics domain across an 85-table PostgreSQL schema, evolved through versioned migrations with zero destructive changes.
Built bidirectional Airtable synchronization on database triggers, a sync queue, and background workers, so operations cut over from the legacy system with zero disruption.

roles.title: Co-Founder & Lead Product Engineer
roles.summary: AWS cost-optimization SaaS, concept to live Marketplace listing.
highlights: Co-founded the company and built the platform as primary engineer: a Next.js and TypeScript frontend on a Go optimization service.
Built multi-tenant B2B authentication with WorkOS — organizations, invitations, role-based permissions, SSO, and organization switching.
Shipped the AWS Marketplace listing end to end, including metering and subscription handling, opening access to AWS's customer base.

roles.title: Front-End Software Engineer
roles.summary: Software supply-chain security and SBOM intelligence.
highlights: Primary front-end engineer on an established team, and top contributor to both the Nx UI monorepo and the flagship dashboard application.
Helped move the platform from REST to GraphQL with URQL and Graphcache, and consolidated legacy code into an Nx monorepo.
Mentored a bootcamp-graduate engineer from roughly 30% to 70–80% of senior velocity within three months, through structured pairing and test-driven development.
